Home.title: UFASNABTORG
Home.tagLine: Production and wholesale of rare earth metals
Home.description: LLC Bashkir Enterprise UFASNABTORG has been manufacturing and supplying copper powders, nickel wire, selenium, zinc, aluminum and other rare earth metals to Russia and abroad since 2005.
Home.aboutP1: LLC Bashkir Enterprise UFASNABTORG was founded in 2005. The company specializes in the manufacture and wholesale of rare earth metals in Russia and abroad.
Home.aboutP2: All products are certified at the Laboratory of Mass Spectrometric and Ecoanalytical Methods (IASH GIREDMET, Moscow). At the buyer's request, we certify products at the independent laboratory of the Institute of Rare Earth and Strategic Metals ISE AG (Switzerland).
Home.aboutP3: The company is certified by the Voluntary Certification System PROMTEKHSERTIFIKATSIYA and holds ISO 9001-2015 certificates. Products are supplied to Germany, Switzerland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, China, Korea, UAE and other countries.

FAQ.q1: Can you send a product sample?
FAQ.a1: Yes, we can send you a product sample. To receive the required sample, please contact us using any convenient method listed in the Contacts section.
FAQ.a2: The price for each item depends on the chemical purity of the specific batch, order volume, country of shipment and other factors discussed during negotiations. Please contact us for more information.
FAQ.a3: All products are accompanied by a full set of export documents, including a certificate of origin. You can request the list of documents using any convenient method.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.heroSubtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal data
PrivacyPolicy.s1Text: This personal data processing policy is drawn up in accordance with the requirements of Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27.07.2006 "On Personal Data" and determines the procedure for processing personal data and measures to ensure their security taken by LLC BP "UFASNABTORG" (hereinafter referred to as the Operator).
PrivacyPolicy.s2Text: The Operator processes personal data for the following purposes: processing product requests, communicating with the client, concluding and executing supply contracts, sending informational messages (with consent).
PrivacyPolicy.s3Text: The Operator processes the following personal data: full name; email address; phone number; content of the message left in the request form. Processing is carried out with the consent of the personal data subject.
PrivacyPolicy.s4Text: Personal data processing is carried out on the basis of: Federal Law No. 152-FZ "On Personal Data"; the consent of the subject to the processing of his personal data; contracts concluded between the Operator and the personal data subject.
PrivacyPolicy.s5Text: The Operator takes the necessary organizational and technical measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, destruction, modification, blocking, copying, distribution. Data is stored on secure servers and is not transferred to third parties, except as provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
PrivacyPolicy.s6Text: The personal data subject has the right to: receive information about the processing of his data; demand clarification, blocking or destruction of data; withdraw consent to the processing of personal data by sending a written notice to the Operator.
PrivacyPolicy.s7Text: The Operator has the right to make changes to this policy. The new edition comes into force from the moment of its publication on the site, unless otherwise provided by the new edition.
